verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Language Identification feature that automatically identifies the language in an audio file [docs-29]. Pricing also advertises a model that transcribes 56 languages without choosing one up front and switches language mid-sentence [docs-31], with bilingual Arabic-English support [docs-30]. Coverage of the core story is clear, but the evidence consists of short snippets. Missing for 10: detail on how language ID is configured and its limits (batch vs. realtime availability, accuracy, supported languages), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
